topic: Teaching kids about money: three jars, one to save, one to spend and one to share.

episode.title: Three Jars, Three Money Jobs

shots.narration: Can three empty jars turn money confusion into a plan?
shots.scene: Bright 3D animated city apartment, vertical 9:16 frame, three empty glass jars on a table, no text.
shots.action: Kash lifts three empty jars together on a small tray.
shots.mood: Curious expression, raised eyebrows, warm morning light.

shots.narration: Kash has coins, but they're all mixed together.
shots.scene: Modern apartment table with a loose pile of plain gold coins beside three empty jars, no text.
shots.action: Kash nudges the loose coin pile with one finger.
shots.mood: Puzzled face, tilted head, bright friendly colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Coin has an idea: save, spend and share!
shots.scene: Apartment tabletop with three glass jars featuring blue, orange and pink bases, no text.
shots.action: Coin sweeps one tiny arm toward the three jars.
shots.mood: Coin smiles widely while Kash watches with an attentive expression.

shots.narration: The saving jar holds money for something later.
shots.scene: Close view of the blue-based glass jar on the apartment table, other jars softly blurred, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides a plain gold coin into the blue-based jar.
shots.mood: Gentle blue highlights, cheerful smile, calm anticipation.

shots.narration: The spending jar holds money for buying things.
shots.scene: Close view of the orange-based glass jar beside a small unmarked shopping basket, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides a plain gold coin into the orange-based jar.
shots.mood: Warm orange accents, welcoming light, practical and cheerful.

shots.narration: [chuckles] The sharing jar holds money to help others.
shots.scene: Close view of the pink-based glass jar with a simple raised heart shape, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides a plain gold coin into the pink-based jar.
shots.mood: Soft pink glow, kind smile, bright friendly surroundings.

shots.narration: For example, Kash divides six coins: two in each jar.
shots.scene: Apartment tabletop with the three coloured jars now empty and six plain coins on a tray, no text.
shots.action: Kash distributes the six coins evenly among the three jars.
shots.mood: Focused smile, tidy composition, clear sparkling glass.

shots.narration: Now each jar has a different money job.
shots.scene: Three coloured jars holding two coins each on a tidy apartment shelf, no text.
shots.action: Kash gives the three jars a satisfied thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Relieved grin, Coin smiling beside the jars, sunny golden light.

shots.narration: [excited] Today, choose three jars; next time, Kash puts them to work!
shots.scene: Bright apartment table with three empty jars on a tray in the foreground, no text.
shots.action: Kash presents the tray of jars toward the viewer.
shots.mood: Inviting smile, Coin beaming beside her, playful bright colours.

episode.endHook: Next time, Kash puts her three jars to work!
episode.description: Coin helps Kash explore a simple way to teach kids about money: jars for saving, spending and sharing. This everyday story offers general money education, not personal financial advice.
